questions.a: IMPORT vs DATA: import_sieve checks who imports a driver. This checks where data lives. A component using sqlite3 or writing structured state to a flat file is invisible to import_sieve.
NOT A DUPLICATE OF IMPORT_SIEVE: the two checks share a WHY (sole path to durable state) but watch different objects. import_sieve watches code; this watches data declarations.

DRIVER vs DECLARATION: the sqlite3 import rule is the driver face (simple, mechanical). The charter declaration sieve is the data face (richer, asks about the component's own claim). Both are needed because the evasion paths are different shapes.
